description: Design tokens for Apple — premium, minimalist, ecosystem-focused campaigns
notes: Apple aesthetic: ZERO card borders, ZERO shadows, ZERO accent stripes
Typography is the hero — massive headings, generous white space
No structured card layouts — just text + image alternating
Single CTA per section, clean bulletproof button
Minimal color palette — primary #1D1D1F, secondary #6E6E73, cta blue #0071E3
